summary: Practise QGIS and QField workflows for checked spatial data, introductory analysis and clear maps. Explore the five-day training outline.
lede: Geospatial analysis turns location data into checked spatial layers, findings and maps for field operations and planning. For field officers, GIS technicians and planning analysts, this training covers capturing location-linked data with QField, checking coordinate references and feature quality, and using QGIS spatial queries and overlays to produce clear maps and operational findings.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who capture, maintain, analyse or communicate spatial data as part of field operations, service planning or asset work. It suits beginners who need a practical route from location records to checked GIS outputs.
modules: QGIS Map Products and Decision Briefs
prerequisites: Basic computer skills are expected; prior GIS experience and programming are not required. Bring a laptop with QGIS and a smartphone with QField installed for the field-capture exercises. Sample GIS files are used for practice.
topics: Data collection, survey design & mobile tools
